verdict.rationale: Datalab converts documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON or chunks, and its docs say Marker 'handles complex layouts', which implies structured rather than flat output. However, no evidence explicitly documents heading detection, section hierarchy or reading-order reconstruction. One hands-on user found it 'reasonable' but saw columns intermingled in tricky layouts, and another reported tables and text boxes messed up. missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy in output, documented reading-order handling, independent corroboration that multi-column reading order is reliably preserved.
